datasets.name: TemplatesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select * from
cm_wr_templates where mehid=:v_mehid and activities_id=:v_activ
order by name

datasets.name: CreditInfoDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.* ,:man as manat ,:dat as data,:gir as GIROW,:fa as FAIZ,:kfaiz as KFAIZ,:cfaiz as CFAIZ
  FROM cm_wr_creditinfo a
 where a.creditid = :crid

datasets.name: BookmarksDataSet
datasets.sql:
select  fieldid, bookmarkname
from cm_wr_bookmarks
where templateid=:templid

datasets.name: ReplaceDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   B.TEMPLATEID , B.BOOKMARKNAME , A.FIELDNAME
FROM
   CM_WR_BOOKMARKS B
 , CM_WR_FIELDS A
WHERE
     (B.FIELDID = A.ID)
   AND templateid = :tid
   AND bookmarkname = :bname

datasets.name: yazi
datasets.sql:
select p.CREDITLINEAMOUNT,v.VALU_NAME ,round(months_between(p.duedatefirstcontract, p.dateofconclusion)) per, h.pledgeprice,p.annualyinterestrate,p.annualbankrate,p.annualypenaltyrate
from cm_active_credits p,avalute v,cm_guarantee h
where p.id=:id 
and p.currency=v.VALUTE and p.id=h.creditid(+)
